meta.name: competitive-analysis-process
meta.description: Orchestrate a complete competitive analysis across six steps, from landscape to strategic direction. Use when you need the full picture, not a single scan or card.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从市场格局到战略方向，完成六步竞品分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要系统化了解竞争环境并制定策略
copy.tagline_en: Complete a six-step competitive analysis from landscape to strategy
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a systematic competitive landscape and strategic direction

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按六步流程组织竞争分析:从市场格局、产品对比、客户需求、商业信息、市场定位到竞争对手战略方向,最后产出作战卡、对比矩阵、定位对策和威胁评估简报。
howto.when: 当用户要求“完整的竞争分析”而非单次扫描,并给出竞品范围或市场、以及该分析要支持的决策时触发。

say.text: 在我的目标市场上跑完整竞争分析,决策是我们是否转向高端。
say.note: 按六步流程自动编排并产出四类成果。

say.text: 竞品定为A和B,跑六步,重点看它们下一步的战略方向。
say.note: 会调用情报收集方法做方向研判。

say.text: 只要针对某竞品跑第2、3、5步,直接出作战卡。
say.note: 按决策裁剪步骤,跳过无关环节。

howto.what_en: Claude now runs competitive analysis as a six-step workflow: landscape, product comparison, customer-need fulfillment, business baseline, positioning, and strategic direction. Outputs: battle cards, comparison matrices, positioning counter-moves, threat assessment briefs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a full competitive analysis is requested (not a one-off scan), typically with a competitor set or market and the decision this analysis supports.

say_en.text: Run the full competitive analysis process on our market — decision: whether we move upmarket.
Competitors are A and B; run all six steps, focusing on their strategic direction.
Only run steps 2, 3, 5 on this one competitor, straight to a battle card.
say_en.note: Scopes the workflow to the decision.
